hypothesis: The one-field planner is sound, but v37 treated intent as a hint and allowed grow to become nukes and an unrestricted boat stream. Constraining the mature executor to action families that match the current intent will make the simple planner causally control behavior without adding tactical instructions.

single_variable.changed: Treat intent as an action-family boundary before delegating exact action and target selection to the mature executor.

boundaries.grow: territory-taking attacks or boats, then non-strike infrastructure
boundaries.secure: build, upgrade, retreat, or boat retreat
boundaries.finish: non-neutral attack, boat, nuke, or warship action

single_variable.safety_override: When the observation reports incoming pressure, the mature executor receives the full safe material menu.
unchanged: three-value one-field planner prompt and response schema
hold preference when no material action exists

local_acceptance: focused intent and integration suites pass
grow cannot choose a nuke while territory or infrastructure growth is legal
secure cannot choose an offensive strike while a secure action is legal
finish cannot choose neutral growth while a rival conversion action is legal
incoming pressure retains the full safe material defense menu
same-fixture differential proves v37 and v38 choose different action families
hosted_kill_bar: any unexplained fallback, degradation, rejection, or parse failure
